title: Transversal tilings in k-partite graphs without large holes
summary: We show that for any constant $μ>0$ and $k\ge 3$, there exists $α>0$ such that the following holds for sufficiently large $n \in \mathbb{N}$. If $G=(V_{1},\ldots,V_{k},E)$ is a spanning subgraph of the $n$-blow-up of $K_{k}$ with ${δ^*}(G)\geq (\frac{1}{2}+μ) n$ and $α^*_{k-1}(G)<αn$, then $G$ has a transversal $K_{k}$-factor. Moreover, the bound $\frac{1}{2}$ is asymptotically tight for the case \(k=3\).
